name: signal_cell2sos
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox cell2sos (Phase 4.10) — convert cell array of {Bi, Ai} pairs to L×6 second-order-section matrix. Linear (length-2) sections zero-padded on right. 2-output form [S, G] = cell2sos(C) extracts leading scalar gain when C{1} = {scalar_b, scalar_a}. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on 12 fingerprints across both help-example forms (with and without leading gain). Octave 11.1.0 ships in core.
